description: Outdoors55 primarily features in-depth knife-making tutorials, sharpening techniques, and practical reviews of blades and sharpening equipment. The videos often demonstrate step-by-step processes like building bevel jigs, heat treating steel, and achieving extreme sharpness through freehand methods and strop progressions. While it began as an outdoor channel, the content now focuses heavily on the science of edges, steel types, and DIY craftsmanship for knife enthusiasts.
